steps.message: {"user_message": "write a warning I can send to staff about this one", "emails": [{"from": "payroll@hr-benefits-portal.net", "subject": "Update your direct deposit before Friday", "body": "Payroll records show your direct deposit details are out of date. Sign in at https://hr-benefits-portal.net/deposit before Friday to avoid a delayed paycheck."}]}

Heads up: a phishing email is circulating that claims your direct deposit details are out of date and pressures you to update them before Friday. It links to hr-benefits-portal.net, which is not our HR system. Do not click the link and do not enter your credentials. Forward the message to security@ as an attachment and then delete it. Payroll will never ask you to confirm banking details by email.
